luckBonus.label: Extra Luck Levels
luckBonus.tooltip:
Adds N levels on top of the proficiency-scaled Luck amplifier.

§8  Prof 1: Luck I + bonus
§8  Prof 2: Luck I + bonus

§8  Prof 4: Luck II + bonus
§8  Prof 5: Luck III + bonus
